title: fix(rest, runtime)!: the /meta action doors and MCP list_actions serve an action entry as the object door projects it (ADR-0106)
body:
security#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibvynRbCtMndW8EHNGc

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — the `/meta` `action` reads (the list, the item read, `/layers` with its `?layers=true` spelling, and `/published`, on both transports) and MCP `list_actions` now answer a caller only the action entries the `/meta` object door's projection serves that caller, which ADR-0106 D1 ("a field the caller cannot read does not exist for that caller, on any plane") already promises, so no stated contract is narrowed; what narrows is the answer to a caller with a `readable: false` field. Nothing is widened: no answer member, error code or status is added; the new exports are the shared projection the doors ask.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: no move — `skills/**` teaches no `/meta` action read; `content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx` and `content/docs/deployment/environment-variables.mdx` state the projection.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`/meta` 的 `action` 读取（列表、单项、`/layers` 及 `?layers=true`、`/published`，REST 与 runtime dispatcher 两端）与 MCP `list_actions`，对每个独立动作条目按 `/meta` 对象门对该调用者的 ADR-0106 投影判定：参数绑定了调用者不可读字段的动作（按参数所指对象判定：有 `objectOverride` 取其目标，否则取动作的 `objectName`；含无所属对象的 global 动作）不再列出，单项读取的回答与不存在的名字逐字节相同；`list_actions` 对 `objectOverride` 参数的摘要改读目标对象的字段。
- **为什么改**：ADR-0106 D1 要求不可读字段在任何门都不存在；`/meta/object` 已隐去这类动作，但独立 `action` 条目的各个读取门与 MCP 的 global 动作仍未投影。
- **风险与回滚**：对带 `readable: false` 字段的调用者是收窄（标题带 `!`）；动作所属对象的字段可见性无法评估时与对象门一样拒绝（`FIELD_VISIBILITY_UNRESOLVED` / 503）。无限制调用者、D4 豁免者（`manage_metadata`、system）、无 security 服务或关闭掩码的部署逐字节不变；执行门（MCP `run_action`、`POST /actions`）及其参数校验与拒绝文案不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`（`projectMetaActionForCaller` 及列表 7a、单项 4a、分层 3a 三步）、`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-object-schema-mask.test.ts`（新增的最后一个 describe）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/mcp-object-schema-mask.test.ts`，预期 `Tests 45 passed (45)`。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` — `projectMetaActionForCaller(sources, action, ownerName)`: one action entry as this caller is served it. The action is projected as its own object's only `actions` entry through `projectMetaObjectSchema` over the posture related to that document (the object door's `maskDeniedFieldReferences` → `actionParamReadsDenied`, `objectOverride` judged on the object it names), not a second rule. A `passthrough` posture serves the entry with no object read. An action with no own-object definition has only its `objectOverride` params judged, each on the caller's posture for the object it names; a posture that cannot be evaluated or is undetermined withholds it.
  - The list chain (step 7a) leaves a withheld entry out. The item chain (step 4a), the layered chain (step 3a, every present layer) and both `/published` doors answer it as a name with nothing behind it. `projectMetaActionItem` is the item-read entry the cached arm and the published doors ask.
- `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-routes.ts` — the cached item arm (the default door for `action`) asks the same projection, and judges `If-None-Match` after it, so a withheld entry is answered `404`, never `304`.
- `packages/metadata-core/src/object-schema-fls.ts` — `actionObjectOverrideTargets` and `actionServedWithoutOwnObject`, the object door's own rule for an action with no own-object definition.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts` — `servedActionObject` delegates to `projectMetaActionForCaller`, so an object-less action is judged on the objects its `objectOverride` params name; `listActions` hands `summarizeAction` the served object of each override target.
- `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts` — `summarizeAction`, `summarizeActionParams` and `resolveDeclaredActionParams` take an optional object lookup and read an `objectOverride` param's field on the object it names; a target the lookup does not resolve reads the own object's field, as before. `enforceActionParams` passes no lookup, so the run doors' validation and refusal text are unchanged.
- `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts` — each transport hands the item, layered and published chains its `object` masker (`resolveObjectMasker`).
- Docs: `connect-mcp.mdx` and `environment-variables.mdx` state the projection. Changeset: a patch for `@objectstack/metadata-core`, `@objectstack/rest` and `@objectstack/runtime`, the BREAKING banner and the ADR-0087 `not-required` disposition.

## Tests

A new top-level `describe` in `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-object-schema-mask.test.ts`: the real `SecurityPlugin` on a real `ObjectQL` over a real `SqlDriver`, the protocol over that engine, `RestServer`'s registered handlers (cached arm, and a deployment with the cache off) and the runtime dispatcher, plus the MCP bridge.

- A member denied a bound field (an own-object `field`, and a global action's `objectOverride` field) is not listed the action, and its item, `/layers`, `?layers=true` and `/published` reads answer byte-identical to an unknown name, on every door. None of the field's label, help text or the param's label appears in the list.
- The cached arm answers a member holding the staff's validator `404`, and the staff still revalidates `304`.
- MCP `list_actions` withholds the global action; an `objectOverride` param is summarised with the target field's label and type.
- Controls: a readable-field action, a field-less action and a readable global override are served to the member as to the staff; an author holding `manage_metadata` and the system context are answered byte-identical to the same caller with no security service, on every sub-door.
- Unit pins: `resolveDeclaredActionParams` with and without the lookup (and `enforceActionParams` unchanged); `actionObjectOverrideTargets` and `actionServedWithoutOwnObject`.

## Acceptance notes

- Ablating the projection (`projectMetaActionForCaller` returns `serve` first) turns the 16 refused legs red (list, item, `/layers`, `?layers=true`, `/published` per door, the `304` leg, MCP global, and the two #31075 legs) while the 29 controls stay green. Ablating the target-field lookup turns the two summary pins red.
- The `/meta` doors read an action's own object from its spec `objectName`; `@objectstack/rest` cannot reach objectql's legacy `object` rung, so an entry carrying only that key is judged as object-less there.
